name: Bounce Ball
author: Addicting Games
description: Bounce Ball is an easy clicker game where your objective is to get the ball through each sliding block! This online game is set against a solid background with simplistic animation. With every game, you get a different pastel-colored background like gray, blue and purple. This game was designed all-around to be entertaining, easy, and relaxing. All you will see is a basic white ball and basic white blocks sliding together as you play through the game. Click on the ball to navigate through the game and avoid the sliding blocks. Keep going as far as you can to beat your own personal best score or to rise up the leaderboards. From the main menu, you can click on the leaderboards to see if you’ve made the cut and see how well you did against your friends here on AddictingGames. You can also click to replay the game to beat your most recent score. This is a great time-killer game that you can play on your mobile device or your computer. There is no tutorial needed because it’s that easy to play!
